ticējums.title: Folk belief:
ticējums.text: Whoever heats the sauna should throw the first steam and invite everyone to bathe, saying: "This ladle is for the spirits!" When everyone has bathed, clean water and a whisk should be left behind, and on the way out one says: "Now, Laimīte, it is your turn to bathe!"
